status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/procure-to-gl/proposed_items.json (screening decision, conversion step, G/L posting lineage and the links and readers around them). Sources are named, never read here; 'source unknown' carries the Dot question that would find one. OntologyProject refs on context/ paths are records of the codex/advisory branch.

gaps.name: ScreeningJob (blank and screened SKUs, quantities, screener, artwork version, rate-card PO, proof and counts, transfers, conversion, invoice, G/L)
gaps.ontology_today: No screening job type, and no Portal model at 1f2d42d records one; the map proposes it as a target.

sources.relation: Screening Process Map descriptor (proposed Screening Job fields)

gaps.dot_question: Where is an outside screening job recorded today (FileMaker layout, Portal page, spreadsheet or email), and who owns the screener's proof and counts?

gaps.name: Screening decision (approval of the screen proof and the accepted and rejected counts that make units good)
gaps.ontology_today: No screening decision; the nearest records are Portal artwork proof-version decisions (not served), which carry no screening counts.
gaps.dot_question: Who approves a screen proof and records the good and rejected counts from the screener, and where is that record kept?

gaps.name: ConversionStep (blank SKU consumed, screened SKU produced, cost rolled under conversion option (a))
gaps.ontology_today: No conversion event; ItemLedgerEntry links only to its item and to receipts, shipments and credit memos by document No.

sources.relation: ItemLedgerEntry link types (for_item, posted_by_receipt, posted_by_shipment, posted_by_credit_memo)

gaps.dot_question: Which Business Central document performs the blank-to-screened conversion under option (a) (assembly order, item reclassification journal or production order), and in which company?

gaps.name: Cost policy decision (the ERP-D-015 exception for screening blanks and the screening clearing account, with approver and date)
gaps.ontology_today: No decision or policy object; ERP-D-015 appears only as schema comments and as a GeneralLedgerEntry description.

sources.relation: app_receipt.freight_cost / duties_cost comments (ERP-D-015: expense G/L, not item cost)

gaps.dot_question: Has the ERP-D-015 exception for screening blanks and the screening clearing account been approved, by whom, and where is that decision recorded?

gaps.name: Product.screened_from (screened SKU -> the blank SKU it is made from)
gaps.ontology_today: No link between two items; the map reports the blank-to-screened SKU link missing.
gaps.dot_question: Does any field or table name the blank SKU a screened SKU is made from (Portal product, FileMaker packaging or BC item), and is it filled for current screened items?

gaps.name: G/L posting lineage (receipt, item ledger entry or conversion -> GeneralLedgerEntry)
gaps.ontology_today: GeneralLedgerEntry links only to its account and, corroborated by document No., to posted purchase and sales invoices; BC value entries are not in the read grammar, so nothing ties item movements to G/L entries.

sources.relation: GeneralLedgerEntry and its links on_account, for_purchase_invoice

gaps.dot_question: Does the Business Central tenant expose Value Entries or the G/L - Item Ledger Relation through any API page (standard v2.0 or a custom page), and under which name?

gaps.name: Portal purchase order and receipt -> Business Central document (entity map)
gaps.ontology_today: BcEntityMapping is declared but unserved; Portal-to-BC links fall back to renumbering and number matches, which are leads.

sources.relation: public.app_bc_entity_map joined by the PO and receipt drain

gaps.name: Supplier deposit -> purchase order or proforma invoice
gaps.ontology_today: Payment links only to a posted purchase invoice (applies_to_purchase_invoice); a deposit paid before any invoice has no link to its PO or PI.
gaps.dot_question: How is a supplier deposit recorded in Business Central (prepayment invoice, or a vendor payment line with which applies-to or external document number), and does it name the PO?

gaps.name: Warehouse transfers of blanks to and from the screener
gaps.ontology_today: RelPublicAppWarehouseTransfer and its lines are generated not_served types; no reader.

gaps.name: Incoming QC records of received packaging
gaps.ontology_today: RelPublicAppIncomingQcRecord is a generated not_served type; no reader.

gaps.name: Screening Process Map originals (the ZIP's HTML, spec JSON and ontology CSV/JSON members)
gaps.ontology_today: Not a row of examples/case_originals.json; only the advisory descriptor with member hashes is pinned, and the Workbench has no verified read of the members.

sources.relation: AGENTS/Ontology UseCases/Screening Process Map.zip version 1.0 (descriptor with member hashes)

gaps.name: Packaging map examples archive members (quotes, PO, PI, deposit, freight)
gaps.ontology_today: The archive row is pinned with extraction incomplete and its members' bodies are not verified, so documents the cards need cannot be cited by content.
